decision.author: codex
decision.rationale: The proposed theta=0.90 area-weighted squared-MISESERI support fails its predeclared full-coverage criterion. Although 180 of 2906 source cells capture 90.0253% of the stress-error proxy mass and cover all 663 tested notch-tip centroids, only 5581/6250 ligament centroids (89.296%) and 2482/2799 hole-boundary centroids (88.675%) are covered. The 669 ligament and 317 hole-boundary counterexamples are sufficient to falsify the required coverage condition. At uncovered points, the graded resolution cap exceeds the required 0.0015 mm maximum; therefore the proposed support cannot establish the declared local phase-field resolution. Furthermore, squared MISESERI is a statistical stress-error proxy, not a certified phase-field error estimator, and the proposed interior maximum-size enforcement has not been qualified for the Abaqus 2023 backend. This rejection applies specifically to the fixed theta=0.90 hypothesis and does not invalidate Method A or establish that another indicator-based strategy would fail. Preserve the original evidence and rejected hypothesis. Do not generate this mesh, silently adjust theta, introduce a predefined crack corridor, authorize PBS execution, or interpret this review as approval of an alternative method. A scientifically distinct sizing hypothesis requires its own evidence and independent review.
